links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT responses on premature ejaculation (FKGL, FRES)
links.effect: Mean FKGL 15.68 ± 1.67 and FRES 15.8 ± 8.73; requires about 14 to 15 years of formal schooling; treatment texts hardest to understand.
links.quote: In addition, the FKGL scores indicate a significant degree of linguistic intricacy, requiring a level of knowledge comparable to about 14 to 15 years of formal schooling in order to understand.

links.outcome: Reading level of ChatGPT patient information versus recommended threshold
links.effect: FKGL 15.68 ± 1.67, FRES 15.8 ± 8.73; complexity exceeds the recommended reading threshold for effective health communication.
links.quote: The results of this research suggest that compared to texts on other topics the PE texts produced by ChatGPT exhibit a higher degree of complexity, which exceeds the recommended reading threshold for effective health communication.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, quality, and readability of ChatGPT responses to patient queries about premature ejaculation without testing any specific guardrail or deployment intervention.
